sourceText: Bought at Ventest Clothing Boutique in Hateno Village (Hood 60, Tunic 120, Trousers 90 rupees); Hood also sold at Enchanted in Kakariko Village.
Bought at Ventest Clothing Boutique in Hateno Village (Helm 180, Armor 250, Greaves 200 rupees). Source 1 also lists the Enchanted shop in Kakariko Village.

Shrine chests: Bandanna in Ree Dahee Shrine (Dueling Peaks), Gear in Chaas Qeta Shrine (Tenoko Island), Boots in Tahno O'ah Shrine (Mount Lanayru). Rebuyable from Granté in Tarrey Town. (Source 1 listed the bonus as a single ★; sources 2 and 3 agree on ★★.)
Bought at Enchanted (Claree's clothing shop) in Kakariko Village (Mask 500, Chest Guard 700, Tights 600 rupees). (Source 1 listed the bonus as a single ★; sources 2 and 3 agree on ★★.)
Bought at the Brazen Beak armor shop in Rito Village; each piece grants one level of Cold Resistance. (Source 1 listed the set bonus as ★★★★; sources 2 and 3 agree on ★★.)

Bought at Ripped and Shredded in Goron City (Helm 2000, Armor 600, Boots 700 rupees). The Flamebreaker Armor is also rewarded by the Fireproof Lizard Roundup side quest. Each piece grants Flame Guard / heat resistance. (Source 1 listed the bonus as ★★★★; sources 2 and 3 agree on ★★.)

Bought from Greta at the Gerudo Secret Club in Gerudo Town (Headband 450, Spaulder 1300, Trousers 650 rupees); also sold by Rhondson at the armor boutique in Tarrey Town. Each piece grants Heat Resistance. (Source 1 listed the bonus as ★★★★; sources 2 and 3 agree on ★★.)

First bought from Vilia at Kara Kara Bazaar during the Forbidden City Entry quest (600 rupees as a set); later sold individually at Fashion Passion in Gerudo Town (180 rupees each). Required vai disguise to enter Gerudo Town; grants Heat Resistance. Not enhanceable. (Source 2 noted a Heat-Resistant ★★ set bonus, but sources 1 and 3 list no set bonus.)

Bought from Greta at the Gerudo Secret Club in Gerudo Town (≈2400 rupees total plus 3 Luminous Stones per piece), unlocked via The Secret Club's Secret quest. Mask glows in the dark; Stal-type enemies ignore Link.

Zora Armor given by King Dorephan in Zora's Domain (Vah Ruta questline); Zora Helm from a sunken chest at Toto Lake; Zora Greaves rewarded for the Lynel Safari side quest (source 1 instead lists the Greaves as bought in Zora's Domain). Pieces increase swim speed. (Source 1 labeled the bonus 'Swim Speed Up ★'; sources 2 and 3 agree on 'Swim Dash Stamina Up ★★'.)

Helm from the Thunder Magnet side quest (Cima at Lakeside Stable); Armor from a chest in Toh Yahsa Shrine; Tights from a chest in Qukah Nata Shrine. Rebuyable from Granté in Tarrey Town. Each piece grants Shock Resistance. (Source 1 listed the bonus as ★★★★; sources 2 and 3 agree on ★★. SourceType varies — chest vs quest — because pieces are scattered across shrine chests and a side quest.)

Chests in the three Lomei Labyrinth shrines: Helm in Tu Ka'loh Shrine (Lomei Labyrinth Island, Akkala), Armor in Dila Maag Shrine (South Lomei Labyrinth, Gerudo), Leg Wraps in Qaza Tokki Shrine (North Lomei Labyrinth, Hebra). Pieces boost attack power. (Source 1 listed the bonus as ★; sources 2 and 3 agree on ★★.)

Crafted/bought from Cherry the robot at the Akkala Ancient Tech Lab using ancient materials and rupees (each ≈2000 rupees plus Ancient Gears, Cores, and Springs/Screws/Shafts). Each piece grants Guardian Resist Up. (Source 2 tagged this 'other'; sources 1 and 3 treat it as a shop/craft purchase.)

Reward for completing all 120 Shrines (A Gift from the Monks); the final monk directs Link to claim the set at the Forgotten Temple. (Source 1 instead places the reward in the Korok Forest / Trial of the Sword area; sources 2 and 3 agree on the Forgotten Temple. Source 3 listed the bonus as ★★★★, but sources 1 and 2 agree on ★★.)

Bought from Kilton at the Fang and Bone monster shop (≈650 Mon total) after freeing all four Divine Beasts. Not dyeable or upgradable; non-enemy NPCs react with fright. (Source 1 listed the bonus as ★; sources 2 and 3 agree on ★★.)

Given by Impa in Kakariko Village after recovering at least one of Link's Captured Memories; reveals enemy HP (like the Hero's Charm). Standalone, cannot be sold. (Source 1 labeled it 'quest' under sourceType differently but agrees on the Impa reward.)

Given by the Old Man on the Great Plateau (cook Spicy Meat and Seafood Fry for him, or claim it from the chest at his cabin / atop Mount Hylia); grants Cold Resistance. Also buyable at Ventest Clothing Boutique in Hateno Village. (Source 1 tagged it 'starting'; sources 2 and 3 tag it 'quest'. Source 3 listed defense 3, but sources 1 and 2 agree on defense 1.)
Worn by Link at the start of the game in the Shrine of Resurrection. (Source 1 lists defense 1 per piece; source 2 lists 0. Only two sources mention this set.)

Reward from Bozai outside Gerudo Town (Link in vai garb) for a photo of the Statue of the Eighth Heroine, during The Eighth Heroine side quest. Rebuyable from Granté in Tarrey Town (800 rupees). Lets Link walk/move quickly on sand without sinking.

Reward from Bozai outside Gerudo Town (Link in vai garb) for a photo of the Sword of the Eighth Heroine (The Forgotten Sword side quest, following The Eighth Heroine). Rebuyable from Granté in Tarrey Town (800 rupees). Lets Link move quickly on snow without sinking.

Given by Riju in Gerudo Town after completing The Thunder Helm side quest (helping all of Gerudo Town, post-Vah Naboris); grants Unshockable / lightning-strike protection. (Source 1 listed defense 3, source 3 listed defense 0; the helm's true base defense is 0, so source 3 is preferred. Source 2 did not include this item.)
Bought from Starlight Memories (Isha's jewelry shop) in Gerudo Town (500 rupees + 3 Rubies). Grants Cold Resistance.
Bought from Starlight Memories (Isha's jewelry shop) in Gerudo Town (800 rupees + 3 Sapphires). Grants Heat Resistance.
Bought from Starlight Memories (Isha's jewelry shop) in Gerudo Town (500 rupees + 5 Topaz). Grants Shock Resistance.
Bought from Starlight Memories (Isha's jewelry shop) in Gerudo Town (200 rupees + 8 Opals). Increases swim speed (Swim Speed Up).
Bought from Starlight Memories (Isha's jewelry shop) in Gerudo Town (1500 rupees + 3 Diamonds). Decreases Guardian laser damage and can be upgraded with diamonds for high defense.
Bought from Starlight Memories (Isha's jewelry shop) in Gerudo Town (rupees + Amber); provides extra defense. (Only sources 1 and 2 include this gemstone accessory.)
Bought from Kilton at the Fang and Bone monster shop (99 Mon). Disguises Link so Bokoblins do not notice him; not enhanceable. (Sources 1 and 3 include this mask.)
Bought from Kilton at the Fang and Bone monster shop (199 Mon, after freeing one Divine Beast). Disguises Link from Moblins; not enhanceable. (Sources 1 and 3 include this mask.)
Bought from Kilton at the Fang and Bone monster shop (299 Mon, after freeing two Divine Beasts). Disguises Link from Lizalfos; not enhanceable. (Sources 1 and 3 include this mask.)
Bought from Kilton at the Fang and Bone monster shop (999 Mon, after freeing three Divine Beasts). Disguises Link from Lynels; not enhanceable. (Sources 1 and 3 include this mask.)

Found in chests inside Hyrule Castle: Cap in Princess Zelda's Room, Uniform near the Dining Hall / Armory corridor, Boots in the Guards' Chamber. Pieces have very low durability and cannot be enhanced past ★★. (Sources 1 and 2 tagged this as a DLC 'EX Royal Guard Rumors' reward; source 3 treats it as base-game Hyrule Castle chests — it is in fact base game, so 'chest' is preferred.)
amiibo-exclusive item scanned from the Sheik amiibo (Super Smash Bros. series); made of Sheikah stealth fabric. (Source 1 lists defense 2, source 3 lists 0; sources 1 and 3 include this item.)
Scanned from the Revali amiibo. (Only source 1 includes this item.)
Scanned from the Urbosa amiibo. (Only source 1 includes this item.)
Scanned from the Daruk amiibo. (Only source 1 includes this item.)
Scanned from the Mipha amiibo. (Only source 1 includes this item.)
Obtained via the amiibo Rune by scanning the Link (Legend of Zelda 8-bit / Super Smash Bros.) amiibo. (Sources 2 and 3 list the Master Sword Beam Up set bonus; source 1 omitted it.)
Obtained via the amiibo Rune by scanning the Toon Link / Wind Waker Link amiibo. (Sources 2 and 3 list the Master Sword Beam Up set bonus; source 1 omitted it.)
Obtained via the amiibo Rune by scanning the Ocarina of Time Link amiibo. (Sources 2 and 3 list the Master Sword Beam Up set bonus; source 1 omitted it.)
Obtained via the amiibo Rune by scanning the Twilight Princess Link / Super Smash Bros. Link amiibo. (Sources 2 and 3 list the Master Sword Beam Up set bonus; source 1 omitted it.)
Obtained via the amiibo Rune by scanning the Skyward Sword Link amiibo. (Sources 2 and 3 list the Master Sword Beam Up set bonus; source 1 omitted it.)

Obtained by scanning the Majora's Mask (Fierce Deity) Link amiibo; each piece grants Attack Up. (Source 2 lists a Charge Atk. Stamina Up ★★ set bonus and the Attack Up per-piece effect; source 1 listed no set bonus. Source 1 named the head piece "Fierce Deity's Mask".)

DLC (The Champions' Ballad) reward from the EX Treasure: Phantasma side quest; found via added treasure-chest locations. Strongest DLC set defensively (24 total). (Source 1 listed no set bonus; source 3 lists Attack Up.)

DLC (The Champions' Ballad) reward from the EX Treasure: Dark Armor side quest; chests in Faron Woods (Corta Lake, Sarjon Bridge, Ebara Forest). Grants a speed bonus and Stal-enemy disguise. (Sources 1 and 2 include this set.)
DLC Expansion Pack reward (EX Treasure: The Merchant's Picture, Xenoblade Chronicles 2-themed side quest). (Only source 1 includes this set.)

DLC reward (EX Treasure: Fairy Clothes); Magnesis-pull chests at the Exchange Ruins, an island near Hyrule Castle, and Mabe Village Ruins. Grants a Night Speed Up / disguise bonus. (Sources 1 and 3 list defense 2 per piece; source 2 lists 0.)
DLC reward (EX Treasure: Twilight Relic side quest); provides Guardian Resist Up. (Source 1 lists defense 7, source 3 lists 0; sources 1 and 3 include this item.)
DLC reward (EX Strange Mask Rumors); found in a chest in an Ogre Tree hollow at the Lost Woods entrance near Korok Forest. Shakes when a hidden Korok is nearby. (All three sources agree; defense 1.)
DLC reward (EX Strange Mask Rumors / EX Treasure quest); most lower-tier enemies do not notice Link while it is worn. (Sources 2 and 3 list defense 0; source 1 listed 1.)
DLC reward (EX Strange Mask Rumors); found in a chest added by the DLC. Enhances sideways/diagonal climbing speed. (Sources 1 and 3 agree; defense 2.)
DLC reward (EX Treasure: Usurper King side quest); found in a chest added by the DLC. (Sources 1 and 3 agree; defense 3.)
DLC reward (EX Treasure: Garish Outfit side quest); drastically increases raft speed when using a Korok Leaf. (Source 1 lists defense 1, source 3 lists 3; both include the item.)
DLC reward (EX Treasure: Ancient Mask side quest). (Only source 1 includes this item.)
